messages:
nina: Opening a follow-up thread for last night's outage window where we saw conntrack saturation on edge NAT boxes that coincided with DNS TTL flips and a spike in TLS handshake retries. Need owners for short/medium-term mitigations and clear ETAs.

kevin: I pulled kernel logs from the affected edge nodes. We saw nf_conntrack table-full events and DNAT churn when authoritative TTLs dropped to 5s during a zone-sync: ```kernel: nf_conntrack: table full, dropping conntrack entry src=10.10.10.12 dst=52.24.33.44 sport=54321 dport=443 proto=6``` That caused many TCP connections to tear and the LB to retry TLS handshakes.

tia: Short-term mitigation idea: 1) raise conntrack_max and hashsize on affected boxes, 2) add a short DNAT debounce layer in the LB edge so we don't immediately rotate backend IPs on every DNS change. I can own the debounce and the canary. ETA canary 2028-03-08, full prod roll 2028-03-10.

kevin: I'll own the kernel tunables and metric: lb.conntrack.saturated_count and node.conntrack.failures. Plan: staged sysctl bump + monitoring. ETA 2028-03-05 for staging changes.

nina: Please also add an alert for lb.conntrack.saturated_count > 5 for 5m -> P1 in prod. Staging threshold: >20 for 10m.

ops-bot: Ticket created: INF-2748 "conntrack saturation + DNAT debounce"  https://issues.redwood/infract/INF-2748 (assigned to kevin,tia)

jon: I'll build a regression harness that simulates TTL flips + large ephemeral client churn: create 2000 short-lived TCP clients and flip authoritative TTL between 5s and 60s. PR by 2028-03-04. Will include Prometheus assertions on conntrack table usage and handshake retry rate.

kevin: Alert notes: prod -> lb.conntrack.saturated_count > 5 for 5m. Add dashboard: per-node conntrack_used / conntrack_max and a heatmap by region.

tia: Canary plan: apply debounce to us-east-1 edge for 4h window 2028-03-08T02:00-06:00Z, monitor handshake_retry_rate and conntrack_saturation. If handshake retry rate drops >80% and no regressions, expand rollout.

nina: Reproducer snippet for SRE/devs: ```for i in $(seq 1 2000); do (nc -z -w1 52.24.33.44 443 &); sleep 0.02; done``` then force TTL flip on authoritative zone and monitor `sum(rate(lb_tls_handshake_retries_total[1m])) by(cluster)` and `sum(node_conntrack_used)`.

ops-bot: Weekly follow-up for INF-2748 scheduled: 2028-03-06T15:00Z. Invitees: kevin,tia,jon,nina.

nina: Owner summary: kevin -> conntrack sysctl + metrics/alert (due 03/05), tia -> DNAT debounce + canary (due 03/08), jon -> regression harness + PR (due 03/04). We'll reconvene after the canary metrics. I'll close this thread when INF-2748 shows stable prod metrics for 72h. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
